notes.title: Quick Clean Ups
notes.notes:
[b]General Update[/b]
A quick spruce up of moves and gameplay.
Still working on cards and the shop but that should be completed soonish!

[b]Spruced up Art[/b]
Small bits of new art and animations here and there to bring the game together
Character Select has been redesigned as well

[b]Enemies inbound![/b]
Enemies now come in sets of waves.
More possible variations of enemies to fight.
